core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house, Lordswood, Chatham
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham, offered at a guide price of £285,000 freehold with no onward chain.

The ground floor has a lounge 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). A lean-to utility is accessed from the kitchen.

The first floor has bedroom 1 at 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"). Bedroom 2 measures 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"). Bedroom 3 is 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). The bathroom has a shower over the bath.

The rear garden measures approx. 9m (30ft). A gate opens onto the shared rear path. Parking is on-street with no permit required.

Gas central heating is installed with a Worcester boiler from 2019. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage are connected. Broadband is FTTC.

Fernhill Close is in Lordswood, Chatham, Kent ME5.

Guide Price £285,000, freehold. Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction is standard – brick under a concrete tiled roof. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. There is a damp mark on the bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. The seller is unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
core.summary: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house in Lordswood, Chatham, offered at a guide price of £285,000 freehold with no onward chain. Three bedrooms, kitchen/diner, lean-to utility, rear garden with gate to shared path.
